inspection_method: Manually viewed native exact preserved PNG and actual QA reduction PNGs through view_image(detail=original); no OCR used.

views.observations: Cream title follows three positions of the continuous soil path. All seven syllables readable. Native flower, leaf, stem, stone, soil details examined.
Three complete words read top-left through middle to lower-right. Plant masses remain distinguishable. No title/plant overlap.
Bright title is the first reading route; distributed plant masses and winding dark path remain visible.

copy_check.comparison: Exact wording and syllables; semantic-word line breaks normalize to required spaces.

mandatory_conditions.requirement: Only required title once, no invented event details, English, numbers or decorative letters
mandatory_conditions.evidence: The only visible text is three complete title words at approximate native bounds x210–480/y320–500; x425–690/y630–800; x570–895/y995–1200. Whole image and two reductions examined; no other letters located.
One fresh native imagegen call without references; one edge-to-edge illustration, no panels, frame, mockup or contact sheet.

mandatory_conditions.requirement: Multiple plant masses and continuous blank path with semantic title reading route
mandatory_conditions.evidence: Dark soil path runs from upper-left/center through middle to lower-right; leafy flowering masses occupy both edges at several heights. Title occupies that path rather than a lower band. Camera feels high-angle with path recession rather than strictly orthographic overhead.

mandatory_conditions.requirement: Night flowers and dark ground identifiable
mandatory_conditions.evidence: Nearly black blue soil, dark green foliage and pale open white flowers with light yellow stamens; no separate daylight sky. Night-opening species taxonomy not established from the stylized image.

mandatory_conditions.requirement: Whole five-image batch count, independence and diversity
mandatory_conditions.evidence: Coordinator manages remaining roles and batch-level verification. This maker did not view other outputs.

retained_defects_uncertainties.impact: Assigned overhead relationship is softened, although distributed masses and title path remain visible.
retained_defects_uncertainties.potential_followup: If coordinator requests repair, flatten camera and retain distributed corridor/title path; no repair made in this initial stage.

retained_defects_uncertainties.location: Title three words, native ranges noted above

retained_defects_uncertainties.impact: Exact text remains readable at all three views; graphic regularity is less strict than intended.
retained_defects_uncertainties.potential_followup: Keep all seven syllables and route; refine stroke/baseline consistency only if requested.

retained_defects_uncertainties.location: Upper-right white flowers and right-middle/right-bottom flower clusters

quality_claim: Observed scope and retained uncertainties only; no high-end certification, authorship claim, botanical-taxonomy claim, maximum-resolution guarantee or print suitability claim.
